title: FeatureObservation
description: One point-in-time row in the immutable market-basic feature artifact.
$comment: The feature engine is not part of this contract. A reader must use the referenced artifact manifest to resolve the selected inputs and must enforce the timestamp and fingerprint invariants documented by ADR 0005.

decision_at.$comment: Explicit historical knowledge cutoff for selecting the inputs used by this row.

input_available_at.$comment: Maximum available_at of the selected input rows; it must be no later than decision_at.

computation_delay_seconds.$comment: Declared deterministic computation delay in whole seconds. available_at must equal input_available_at plus this duration.

available_at.$comment: Exact feature availability, after computation. Consumers must gate on this field at their own decision_at.

input_fingerprint.$comment: SHA-256 of the canonical input-selection envelope recorded by the feature manifest.

artifact.$comment: Immutable artifact identity and producer metadata. It must match the enclosing feature manifest.

features.$comment: The closed market-basic 1.0.0 registry. Every value is an exact decimal string or null; null is a defined unavailable result, not a missing column.
